data: Synthetic API fixtures; no live provider/backend qualification.
changes: Theme control only in Account settings → Appearance; removed from global and workspace headers and authentication.
Dark navigation uses the operational dark canvas, panel controls, text, borders, accent and focus. Light navigation retains charcoal.
Workspace selection keeps working in memory when browser persistence is blocked; theme settings remain reachable.
Existing shared UI/frontend/independent Embed ownership preserved.

checks.name: Complete frontend unit suite
checks.command: VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 VITE_CHAT_EMBED_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8081 VITE_WOOBE_EDITION=core npm --prefix packages/woobe-frontend run test:run

checks.name: Complete production browser suite
checks.command: cd tests/e2e && CI=true WOOBE_CAPTURE_DOCS=1 WOOBE_CAPTURE_REFINEMENT=1 WOOBE_REQUIRE_GEORGIA=1 PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/chromium PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/workspace/.playwright npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --workers=2
checks.scope: Builds frontend and Embed; route/overlay/navigation/authority checks, actual fonts, themes, unsaved workspace state and native zoom at 125%, 150%, 200%. Includes regenerated main-page and workspace captures.

checks.name: Desktop/mobile navigation captures in both themes
checks.scope: Same built application, navigation-contrast.spec.ts, isolated output directory and screenshot:on. Shared Workspace/Project palette, active text and focus contrast, Account settings portal, selected axe rules, Escape and focus restoration.

screenshots.scope: Main pages plus existing light/dark Agent and Network comparisons; navigation review artifacts remain outside the gallery.

manual_visual_review: Project Overview navigation in light/dark at 1440×1100 and dark mobile navigation at 390×1100.
Updated Project Overview README image and mobile Playground; Agent and Network headers without the theme control.
skills: Existing frontend-design and Guild v2 contracts; user typography and theme requirements take precedence. Skill files unchanged.
remote_ci: Local checks above are complete. GitHub workflows for the newly pushed source are separate and are not represented as completed by this record.
failure_followup: The first full run passed 155 checks and exposed an uncaught WorkspaceProvider storage write after authentication in the blocked-storage scenario. Optional writes now catch storage failures like the existing reads. The regression additionally requires no page errors and verifies the preference falls back to System after reload without persistence.

preceding_validation.scope: Earlier shared component/Embed verification and CI failure diagnosis remain recorded at the preceding source. Those independent suites were not rerun for this scoped navigation/control change; the current frontend unit and production browser results are listed above.

limits: Selected contrast, axe and keyboard checks are not a complete accessibility certification.
Local Chromium 154 and installed Georgia may rasterize differently from pinned CI Chromium 136 and other client fonts.
